title: Banco de Dados Resolutivo (BDR) / Resolutive Database Engine — v1.2.0 Release Candidate 4
description: BDR v1.2.0-rc4 adds the Atomic C ABI v2 symbol bdr_atomic_c_clear() for a durable logical clear in the BDW4 WAL. The published GitHub tag points to 317882a00f041fc1568ff986af8016b09453f21a. This is a release candidate, while v1.1.0 remains the stable line. Software DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.22948288.
